title: At the Restaurant
text:
Today Tom goes to a small restaurant with his family. The menu has many good things to eat. There is soup, chicken, and rice. Tom reads the menu slowly.

The waiter comes to the table with a smile. Tom orders chicken and a glass of water. His sister orders soup. They all like the food very much.

options: Chicken and a glass of water

questions.text: How does the family probably feel about the meal?
options: They are happy with the food
They are angry with the waiter

questions.text: Why does Tom read the menu slowly?
options: He wants to choose his food carefully
He is very hungry and in a hurry

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks that you can order in a restaurant
a person who brings food and drinks to people in a restaurant
a warm liquid food, usually made with vegetables or meat
a piece of furniture where people sit to eat

paragraph_translations: Hoje, Tom vai com a família a um restaurante pequeno. O cardápio tem muitas coisas boas para comer. Há sopa, frango e arroz. Tom lê o cardápio devagar.
O garçom chega à mesa com um sorriso. Tom pede frango e um copo de água. A irmã dele pede sopa. Todos gostam muito da comida.
